title: ID0407467-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001360] plug stucks when stopping a session (C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On both the Sicharge D and the Dispencer, charging sessions are started successfully. However, there are issues when stopping a charging session. The plug then gets stuck with the customer, preventing the customer from leaving.
Root cause: Unknown
Solution:
Docker restart
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: Out of warranty since 12/7/2024
Notes from ES to NOC [ 06/03/2025]
Note:
As the charger is Out of warranty, remote activities where limited from my side (Example - EcoG FW update, SECC reboot & etc) - to avoid the risk associated with a hardware failure or site intervention
